name: angular-new-app
title_zh: 脚手架一敲就带路由、SSR 和现代写法的 Angul
tagline_zh: 别再从零配 Angular 了。它按官方最新规范生成项目，路由、SSR、独立组件、信号全给你摆好，你直接写业务就行。
tagline_en: Stop hand-wiring Angular setup. It scaffolds a project with routing, SSR, standalone components, and signals—so.
desc_en: Creates a new Angular app using the Angular CLI. This skill should be used whenever a user wants to create a new Angular application and contains important guidelines for how to effectively create a modern Angular application.
why_zh: 它把 Angular CLI 的交互式提问变成一次说清，并注入当前官方推荐的项目结构。
why_en: It turns Angular CLI's interactive prompts into one clear command and injects the latest official project structure, saving you.
limit_zh: 只负责生成新项目骨架，不含组件、服务等业务代码生成；需要本机已装 Node.js 和 Angular CLI。
limit_en: Scaffolds new project skeletons only—no component/service generation. Requires Node.js and Angular CLI installed locally; dependencies still need.
title_en: Scaffold a modern Angular app with routing, SSR, and best.
